rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account and inspected the user’s orders and product variants. It selected the appropriate delivered laptop (15-inch, i5, 16GB, 512GB SSD) and an available replacement matching the requested specs (i7, 8GB, 1TB SSD). However, the agent executed the exchange (a write action) and charged the price difference without first stating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Subsequent information about the process and charge amount appears consistent with tool outputs, but the lack of pre-change confirmation triggers a fail under the stated criteria.
